## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest complete solution.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves Paperplane's local-first boundaries.
- [ ] Observable behaviour changes include tests.
- [ ] Affected documentation is updated.
- [ ] No API keys, private documents, provider responses, or generated user results are included.
- [ ] Any submitted fixtures are synthetic, redacted, or clearly redistributable.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under Paperplane's MIT License.
